newsitem.title: USA: Strouds says president and CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Strouds says president and CEO resigns.

text.p: Strouds Inc said Tuesday that Wayne Selness had resigned as president, chief executive and a director due to a difference in merchandising philosophy.
Wilfred Stroud, chairman, issued a statement thanking Selness "for his contributions to the company during his 17 years of dedicated service."
Selness said his resignation will not affect the company's previously announced restructuring plan.
On an interim basis, Stroud said he will assume the day-to-day responsibility for running the company until a successor to Selness is named.
